gaps.title: PA-1400 base RJ45 link settings
gaps.current_known_behavior: The ports support 10M, 100M and 1G; generic SDK has direct link nodes.
gaps.evidence_limit: Neither source establishes PA-1400 acceptance, defaults, or exported speed/duplex nodes.
gaps.missing_fact: Whether omitted, auto, or numeric speed/duplex nodes are valid on each exact group.
gaps.why_blocking: Preserving source manual fields may yield an invalid target candidate.
gaps.required_evidence: Official PA-1410 and PA-1420 interface export/config reference covering default and manual speed and duplex.
gaps.next_action: Request exact-model XML examples for both base RJ45 groups.
gaps.future_renderer_dependency: Controlled speed/duplex normalization or explicit preservation after qualification.

gaps.title: Optical data-port HA1 remapping
gaps.current_known_behavior: Optical dataplane ports can be repurposed for HA1.
gaps.evidence_limit: Hardware evidence does not describe the exported remap node or references during interface rename.
gaps.missing_fact: Exact remap XML, its dependency path, and whether rename must rewrite or block it.
gaps.why_blocking: A candidate could silently retain a stale HA reference.
gaps.required_evidence: Official PA-1400 HA1 remap XML/config hierarchy plus reference semantics for a renamed optical port.
gaps.next_action: Seek a vendor-authored remap export or TAC hierarchy answer; define a future synthetic reference test.
gaps.future_renderer_dependency: HA remap parser and reference rewrite or explicit blocker after evidence closure.

gaps.title: Multi-Gig target link serialization
gaps.current_known_behavior: Physical ports support 2.5G and 5G; generic SDK exposes link-speed.
gaps.evidence_limit: Current English PA-1400 front-panel page proves 2.5G/5G physical rates but does not state an RJ45 auto-only restriction. An official Chinese hardware PDF copyrighted 2023 says RJ45 speed and duplex are auto-only, but its revision is historical/localized and does not establish current behavior or XML. Generic PAN-OS 11.x help, CLI, API, and SDK cannot establish PA-1410/1420 values or defaults.
gaps.missing_fact: For PA-1410 ports 9-12 and PA-1420 ports 5-8/9-12 on supported PAN-OS trains: whether speed and duplex are auto-only or configurable; exact 2.5G/5G representation if configurable; and independent omitted/default versus explicit-auto XML and manual-value behavior.
gaps.why_blocking: The renderer cannot safely normalize or preserve source link values on these groups.
gaps.required_evidence: Current authoritative PA-1410/PA-1420 model- and train-specific statement reconciling the historical Chinese auto-only wording with current English documentation, plus accepted/exported 2.5G, 5G, auto, and omitted speed/duplex XML or an explicit statement that manual rates are unsupported.
gaps.next_action: Ask Palo Alto Networks TAC/Engineering to reconcile the 2023 Chinese hardware PDF with the current English page and provide per-model/per-train exact speed and duplex XML/default/acceptance behavior for the three Multi-Gig groups.
gaps.future_renderer_dependency: Set/remove link-speed and normalize duplex only after exact evidence.
gaps.notes: OFFICIAL_SOURCE_DISCREPANCY: historical Chinese PDF asserts auto-only RJ45; current English page is silent, not an explicit contradiction. Neither source proves XML. PoE remains a separate P1 gap.

gaps.title: PA-1400 optical link and optic state
gaps.current_known_behavior: SFP groups are 1G; SFP+ groups may be 1G or 10G by optic.
gaps.evidence_limit: No exact export/acceptance rule or target installed-optic identity is established.
gaps.missing_fact: Valid speed/duplex XML per group and which target optic/rate is intended.
gaps.why_blocking: Source-side speed cannot establish the target transceiver or valid target XML.
gaps.required_evidence: Official PA-1400 optical XML examples for 1G/10G and target optic/rate supplied by operator where selectable.
gaps.next_action: Research exact-model optical exports; define minimum optic/rate input before implementation.
gaps.future_renderer_dependency: Optic context input and qualified link-setting operation.

gaps.title: PoE configuration and interface references
gaps.current_known_behavior: Ports 9-12 support PoE; official PoE guidance describes per-port controls and shared budget.
gaps.evidence_limit: Registered front-panel evidence does not prove exported PoE XML, rename references, or preservation behavior.
gaps.missing_fact: PoE hierarchy, interface reference form, defaults, and rename/preservation effects.
gaps.why_blocking: Blind subtree movement could alter power behavior or leave an old interface reference.
gaps.required_evidence: Official PoE XML/config hierarchy showing port enable, reserved power, budget, and renamed interface references.
gaps.next_action: Request a vendor-authored PA-1400 PoE export and document reference behavior.
gaps.future_renderer_dependency: PoE semantic parser and reference/preservation model after evidence closure.

gaps.title: PA3200 auto-only RJ45 speed and duplex
gaps.current_known_behavior: Hardware requires automatic speed and duplex; generic SDK exposes direct child nodes.
gaps.evidence_limit: Official PA-3200 hardware establishes auto-only speed and duplex. PAN-OS 10.2/11.1 web help, 11.1 CLI hierarchy, XML API/XPath guidance, and pinned SDK describe generic fields or methods but do not establish PA-3220/3250/3260 accepted XML, omission defaults, or manual-value handling.
gaps.missing_fact: For PA-3220, PA-3250, and PA-3260 ports 1-12 on each supported PAN-OS train: whether speed and duplex must each be omitted, explicitly auto, or represented otherwise; whether manual nodes are rejected, ignored, or normalized.
gaps.why_blocking: Generic renderer preserves source manual settings and could produce an invalid auto-only target.
gaps.required_evidence: Authoritative TAC/Engineering answer or vendor-authored exact-model export/acceptance matrix for PAN-OS 10.1, 10.2, 11.0, and 11.1, independently covering link-speed and link-duplex default, explicit auto, and manual values on RJ45 1-12.
gaps.next_action: Ask Palo Alto Networks TAC/Engineering for per-model and per-train accepted/exported speed and duplex XML, omission defaults, and manual-value behavior; retain candidate blocking until a deterministic rule is established.
gaps.future_renderer_dependency: Remove or set both link nodes with preservation inverse after evidence closure.
gaps.notes: Phase 6A public-source review found no model-specific serialization/default proof. PAN-OS 11.2 CLI changes are not applicable to modeled PA-3200 trains.
